landmarks.note: Statue of Liberty: the region named New York (spec §16.3); Manhattan's tile and New York City's points lie in the New Jersey region on this map
Empire State Building: the region named New York, as the Statue of Liberty
Christ the Redeemer, Rio de Janeiro

dams.note: Hoover Dam (Boulder Dam), Black Canyon on the Nevada–Arizona line; the lower Colorado runs on between Arizona and California
Grand Coulee Dam; the lower Columbia forms the Washington–Oregon line
Norris Dam on the Clinch; the Tennessee runs on through northern Alabama and back north through Kentucky to the Ohio
Dneproges, Zaporizhzhia; the lower Dnieper runs to Kherson
Möhne Dam, Sauerland; the Möhne and the Ruhr below it, down to the Rhine at Duisburg, lie in the dam's own region
Edersee Dam; the Eder and the Fulda (Kassel) lie in the dam's region, the Weser below Hann. Münden in Lower Saxony
Kembs Dam on the Rhine, Haut-Rhin; the Rhine runs on between Alsace and Baden, then past the Palatinate
Galloway hydro scheme (Tongland, Glenlee, the Ken); the Dee runs to Kirkcudbright in the dam's own region
Vemork power station and heavy water plant, Rjukan; no downstream region (spec §16.4)
